# Concern probes

A probe is a concern that is easy to forget and expensive to forget late. Each applicable probe has to be answered on the feature as `addressed` (pointing at the elements that deal with it), `na` (with the reason) or `deferred` (with a reason and a date). Silence blocks `specified`.

| Probe | Module | Applies to | Counts as addressed by | The question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `failure-paths` Failure paths | core | tiers 1, 2 | `FLW`, `RULE`, `REQ` | What happens when it goes wrong: invalid input, a failing dependency, an interrupted action, partial completion? What does the person see, and is anything left half done? |
| `first-use` First use and empty state | core | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing; facets has_ui | `SCR`, `FLW`, `REQ` | What does a person see the first time, before any data exists? How do they get started, and how do they find this? |
| `concurrency` Concurrency and duplicates | core | tiers 1, 2; facets writes_data | `RULE`, `REQ`, `FLW`, `STM` | What happens if two people change the same thing at once, or the same person submits twice, or a request is retried? Is it safe to repeat? |
| `deletion` Deletion and retention | core | tiers 1, 2; facets writes_data | `RULE`, `REQ`, `STM`, `FLW` | What happens when this is deleted or archived: what happens to related data, can it be restored, and how long is it kept? |
| `audit` Audit trail | core | tiers 1, 2; facets writes_data; any of handles_money, handles_pii | `REQ`, `RULE`, `EVT` | Is it recorded who did what and when, can that be seen by the right people, and can it be altered? |
| `limits` Limits and quotas | core | tiers 1, 2; any of writes_data, user_content | `RULE`, `REQ`, `ENTL` | Which limits apply: size, count, rate, length? What does the person see at the limit, and what is the limit protecting? |
| `lists` Lists, search and bulk actions | core | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing or admin; facets has_ui and writes_data | `SCR`, `REQ`, `FLW` | When the data grows, how do people find, sort, filter and page through it, and can they act on many items at once? |
| `import-export` Getting data in and out | core | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing or admin; any of user_content, writes_data | `FEAT`, `REQ`, `API`, `FLW` | Can people bring their data in and take it out, in which formats, and with what limits? |
| `accessibility` Accessibility | core | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets has_ui | `REQ`, `SCR`, `OBL` | Can it be used with keyboard only and with a screen reader? What about contrast, focus, motion and error announcements? Which standard is the target? |
| `localisation` Localisation | core | tiers 1, 2; any of has_ui, sends_messages | `REQ`, `RULE`, `OBL` | Which languages, date, number and currency formats, time zones and text directions must work, and what is the fallback? |
| `performance` Performance and volume | core | tiers 1, 2; any of writes_data, has_api, has_ui | `REQ` | How fast must it be, at what volume, for how many people at once? Which number would make it unacceptable? |
| `observability` Observability | core | tiers 1, 2; any of async, external_dependency, handles_money | `REQ`, `MET`, `RUN` | How would you know it is broken before a customer tells you: which signals, which alerts, who responds? |
| `rollout` Rollout and migration | core | tiers 1 | `RUN`, `REQ`, `RLS`, `FLW` | How does it reach existing people and data: a flag, a phased rollout, a data migration or backfill? How is it switched off? |
| `analytics` Product analytics | core | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing; facets has_ui | `EVT`, `MET` | Which events show whether people find and use it, and which metric would tell you it works? |
| `abuse` Abuse and misuse | core | tiers 1, 2, 3; any of public, user_content, has_api | `REQ`, `RULE`, `RISK` | How could someone misuse it: spam, scraping, malicious input or uploads, enumeration, cost attacks? What limits and checks stop them? |
| `personal-data` Personal data | compliance | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets handles_pii | `REQ`, `RULE`, `OBL`, `RUN` | Why is the data collected and on which basis? Is it the minimum needed? Can the person see, correct, export and erase it, and how long is it kept? |
| `tenant-isolation` Tenant isolation | tenancy | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets tenant_data | `REQ`, `RULE`, `TST` | How is this kept from leaking across tenants, and how is that proven by a test that tries? |
| `tenant-states` Tenant states | tenancy | tiers 1, 2; facets tenant_data and writes_data | `RULE`, `REQ`, `STM` | What happens in a trial that has ended, a suspended, downgraded or cancelled tenant? Can they still read, export, or pay? |
| `session-and-revocation` Sessions and revoked access | identity | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing or admin; not public | `RULE`, `REQ`, `FLW` | What happens if the session expires, the role changes or access is revoked while this is in use or half done? |
| `plan-gating` Plan gating | commercial | tiers 1, 2; kind user_facing or admin or integration | `ENTL` | Is access to this limited by plan? If so, which entitlement gates it and what does a person on a lower plan see? If it is on every plan, say so. |
| `billing-impact` Billing impact | commercial | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets handles_money | `RULE`, `REQ`, `FLW`, `TST` | How do amounts get calculated, rounded and taxed? What about currency, proration, refunds, failed payments and disputes? |
| `usage-metering` Usage metering | commercial | tiers 1, 2; any of writes_data, user_content, has_api | `RULE`, `ENTL`, `EVT`, `MET` | Is usage counted, for limits or for billing? What exactly is counted, when, and what if the count is wrong? |
| `dependency-failure` When a dependency fails | integrations | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets external_dependency | `FLW`, `RULE`, `REQ`, `RUN` | What happens when the other system is slow, down, wrong or sends the same thing twice? Timeouts, retries, fallbacks, reconciliation. |
| `event-delivery` Event delivery | integrations | tiers 1, 2; facets async | `REQ`, `RULE`, `EVT` | Can events arrive late, twice or out of order? What guarantee is given, and what happens to the ones that fail? |
| `api-contract` API contract | public-api | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets has_api | `API`, `REQ`, `RULE` | How is it versioned, what counts as breaking, how are errors, pagination, rate limits and idempotency handled, and how are changes announced? |
| `support-access` Support and operations access | back-office | tiers 1, 2; any of writes_data, handles_money | `FEAT`, `RUN`, `REQ` | Can support staff see what happened and fix it? How is that access limited, recorded and, if it means acting as the customer, disclosed? |
| `messaging-preferences` Message preferences and delivery | lifecycle-comms | tiers 1, 2, 3; facets sends_messages | `MSG`, `RULE`, `REQ` | Who can opt out, how, and of what? What are the frequency limits, the legal footer and unsubscribe rules, and what happens when delivery fails? |
